cat > /app/output/gen.py <<'PY'
"""Copy the supplied silhouette using pressure-controlled, overlapping brush sweeps.
The complete joint trajectory is recorded from the frozen robot instance.
"""
import os,time,json,argparse
import numpy as np
import cv2
from PIL import Image
from rcb_brush import Session, WangBrush, BRUSH_WANG

PIX=.22185986964255727

def main():
 ap=argparse.ArgumentParser();ap.add_argument('--pitch',type=int,default=2);ap.add_argument('--width',type=float,default=1.4);ap.add_argument('--speed',type=float,default=30);ap.add_argument('--score',action='store_true');args=ap.parse_args()
 s=Session('/app/instance.json',render=False);s.reset();s.record_start();p=s.primitives();t=time.time()
 p['move_tip']([-.1,.15,.06],speed=.12)
 p['move_tip']([-.1,.15,.024],speed=.03,settle=12)
 p['move_tip']([-.1,.15,.06],speed=.05,settle=5)
 mask=np.array(Image.open('/app/target.png'))[:,:,0]<100
 # Erode only across each sweep to protect the upper and lower outlines.
 rad=max(1,int(round(args.width/PIX/2)))
 interior=cv2.erode(mask.astype('uint8'),np.ones((2*rad+1,1),np.uint8))
 b=WangBrush(BRUSH_WANG); depth=(args.width+.3)/1.187;off=b.offset_of(depth/1000)*1000;drag=b.drag_of(depth/1000)*1000
 rows=[]
 for ri,v in enumerate(range(np.where(mask)[0].min()+rad,np.where(mask)[0].max()-rad+1,args.pitch)):
  edges=np.diff(np.r_[0,interior[v],0].astype(int));spans=list(zip(np.where(edges==1)[0],np.where(edges==-1)[0]-1))
  if ri%2:spans=spans[::-1]
  for l,r in spans:
   if (r-l)*PIX<drag+.4: continue
   direction=1 if ri%2==0 else -1
   start=((l if direction>0 else r)+.5)*PIX
   end=((r if direction>0 else l)+.5)*PIX
   rows.append((start,end,(v+.5)*PIX,direction))
 print('SWEEPS',len(rows),'depth',depth,'off',off,'drag',drag,flush=True)
 # All positions below are sheet millimetres and press millimetres.
 current=None
 def xyz(pt):
  x,y=s.geo.mm_to_world(pt[0],pt[1]);return np.array([x,y,.02-pt[2]/1000])
 def accurate_ik(pos):
  r=s.kinematics({'op':'ik','targets':{'tip':list(pos)+list(s.tip_down_quat())},'seed':s.hold_action().tolist(),'tol_pos_m':1e-5,'tol_rot_rad':1e-3})
  if not r['ok']: raise RuntimeError(r)
  return np.array(r['q'])
 def move(pt,speed=30,settle=0):
  nonlocal current
  pt=np.array(pt,float)
  if current is None:current=pt.copy()
  n=max(1,int(np.ceil(np.linalg.norm(pt-current)/(speed/20))))
  old=current.copy()
  for i in range(1,n+1):
   want=old+(pt-old)*i/n
   # A modest lookahead compensates the measured drive lag.
   ahead=want+(pt-old)/n*1.3 if i<n else want
   s.step(accurate_ik(xyz(ahead)))
  current=pt
  for _ in range(settle):s.step(accurate_ik(xyz(pt)))
 start,end,y,di=rows[0];root=start+di*drag
 p['move_tip'](xyz([root,y,-10]),speed=.1,settle=8)
 current=np.array([root,y,-10.])
 move([root,y,.20],speed=5,settle=15)
 for k,(start,end,y,di) in enumerate(rows):
  root=start+di*drag
  move([root,y,.20],speed=40,settle=8)
  # Gather, then open the hairs while pulling along the sweep.
  n=18
  for j in range(1,n+1):
   z=.20+(depth-.20)*j/n
   o=b.offset_of(z/1000)*1000
   move([root+di*o,y,z],speed=5)
  move([end+di*off,y,depth],speed=args.speed,settle=6)
  # Reduce bend as pressure decreases: the root stays at the edge.
  for j in range(1,n+1):
   z=depth+(.20-depth)*j/n
   o=b.offset_of(z/1000)*1000
   move([end+di*o,y,z],speed=5)
  move([end,y,.20],speed=5,settle=8)
  if k%50==0:print('progress',k,'steps',s.n_steps,'sec',round(time.time()-t,1),flush=True)
 move([current[0],current[1],-12],speed=5,settle=15)
 actions=s.record_stop();s.save_trajectory(actions,'/app/output/trajectory.npz')
 Image.fromarray(s.canvas()).save('/app/output/canvas.png');np.save('/app/output/ink.npy',s.ink())
 pred=s.ink()>=.5
 print('LOCAL',{'iou':float((pred&mask).sum()/(pred|mask).sum()),'recall':float((pred&mask).sum()/mask.sum()),'n_strokes':len(s.strokes()),'steps':len(actions),'time':time.time()-t},flush=True)
 if args.score:
  metrics=s.score();print('SCORE',json.dumps(metrics),flush=True);json.dump(metrics,open('/app/output/metrics.json','w'),indent=2)
if __name__=='__main__':main()
